description: Site footer with an optional WP nav menu and a copyright line. Reads a registered WP nav menu by theme location slug. Template-owned chrome (issue 223): it is rendered once by the theme, never composed. Its content and colors are set through whitelisted site options (update_site_option), NOT by composing a footer or passing props directly. The props below document the template contract; base.php maps the pp_footer_* site options onto them.

location.description: WP theme location slug for the footer nav menu.

show_logo.description: Opt-in: render the site logo in the footer. Defaults OFF so existing footers are unchanged. When true, uses the same resolution as the nav logo.

logo_text.description: Footer logo text wordmark (only when show_logo is true). Falls back to pp_site_title() when empty.

logo_id.description: Media Library attachment ID for the footer logo image (NOT a URL; only when show_logo is true). Must be an image attachment; a non-image or non-existent ID is rejected when the action is validated (same rule as the pp_logo_id site option). Set via the pp_footer_logo_id site option (issue 335) so a light logo variant can serve the dark footer while pp_logo_id stays the header logo. Resolution: this prop (pp_footer_logo_id), then the pp_logo_id site option, then the WP custom_logo theme-mod.

logo_alt.description: Alt text for the footer logo image. Defaults to the attachment's own alt metadata, then logo_text/site title.

bg.description: Footer background (issue 300; widened to accept gradients in issue 333). Set via the pp_footer_bg site option; emitted as the --footer-bg custom property. Accepts a CSS color (hex, rgb()/hsl(), transparent, currentColor, or a known color-token reference) OR a bounded linear-gradient()/radial-gradient() with 2+ color stops — the shared `gradient` slot type. Empty = the default light surface. This is the primary dark-marketing-footer control.

text.description: Footer text color (issue 300). Set via the pp_footer_text site option; emitted as --footer-text. Applies to the blurb, contact block, and copyright. Same color validation as bg. Empty = inherit / the muted default.

link_color.description: Footer nav-link color (issue 300). Set via the pp_footer_link_color site option; emitted as --footer-link-color. Same color validation as bg. Empty = the muted default.

blurb.description: Short brand/description line under the footer logo (issue 300). Set via the pp_footer_blurb site option. Plain text; newlines render as line breaks.

contact.description: Contact/secondary text block, e.g. an address or email (issue 300). Set via the pp_footer_contact site option. Plain text; newlines render as line breaks. Rendered inside an <address> element; recognizable email addresses become mailto: links and international phone numbers (an explicit leading +) become tel: links (issue 427). The value stays free text — text that matches neither passes through unchanged.

copyright.description: Configurable copyright line (issue 300). Set via the pp_footer_copyright site option. When empty, the footer renders the default line '© <year> <site title>. All rights reserved.'. When set, this string replaces it verbatim (include the year yourself).

menu_label.description: Optional heading above the footer nav menu (issue 335). Set via the pp_footer_menu_label site option. Plain text; empty = no heading (the unlabelled menu of issue 300).

contact_label.description: Optional heading above the contact block (issue 335). Set via the pp_footer_contact_label site option. Plain text; empty = no heading. Only rendered when contact is also set.

note.description: Optional secondary line for a delimited bottom bar (issue 335). Set via the pp_footer_note site option. When NON-EMPTY, the copyright moves into its own delimited band (border-top) and this note renders opposite it; empty = the copyright renders inline exactly as issue 300 did. Plain text; newlines render as line breaks.
